summary: Grupo Cibest S.A. filed a Form 6-K announcing board approval of a 2026 share buyback program authorizing up to COP 1.35 trillion (approximately USD 325 million) in common shares, preferred shares, and ADRs over three years until April 21, 2029, while terminating the 2025 program. The 2025 program repurchased 601,452 common shares and 12,164,612 preferred shares (5,137,320 via ADRs) at COP 690,022 million, 51.11% of its authorized amount. A meeting on March 24, 2026 authorized the 2026 program. The filing provides outstanding share counts for context. No specific price, premium, or advisor named. The termination of the prior program and launch of a larger new one signals sustained capital return commitment. Watch execution pace and regulatory updates in Colombia.
